title: Sovereignty snapshot scheduler and pin reconciliation
creator: Ava Patel
description: Deliver a scheduled snapshot and reconciliation service for Hosted endpoints that: (1) periodically collects endpoint-to-region bindings and effective retention policies, (2) packages attestation-ready evidence bundles for auditors, and (3) reconciles live routing state against declared tenant pin preferences. The feature must surface drift, enable automated remediation suggestions, and export legally consumable bundles for compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled job exists that snapshots all hosted endpoint mappings (endpoint id, tenant id, active region, last-served-region) once per 24h and on-demand via API
The snapshot includes retention settings, route policy metadata, and the last 30 days of region-failover events for each endpoint
An evidence bundle generator can produce a ZIP containing: snapshot JSON, signed route-change log (RFC3339 timestamps), retention policy declarations, and a human-readable proof summary
Console UI shows a per-tenant ‘Sovereignty health’ panel with drift score, last snapshot timestamp, and one-click evidence export
A reconciliation job flags mismatches between tenant-declared pins and actual routing for >1% of traffic and surfaces automated remediation steps
APIs are rate-limited and scoped to org-admin with audit logging for exports
End-to-end test coverage for snapshot, export, and reconciliation workflows exists in CI with mock region failovers
tasks: Draft data model for snapshot (endpoint, tenant, route history, retention policy, metadata)
Design evidence bundle format and minimal legal fields with Legal team
Backend: implement scheduler, snapshot store, on-demand snapshot API
Backend: implement reconciliation worker and remediation suggestion generator
Console: sovereignty health card and export flow (UX + frontend)
Compliance: run tabletop with internal audit + Legal to validate bundle
Integrations: wire export to S3-compatible endpoint and internal evidence catalog
Create CI e2e tests and dashboarding for snapshot freshness
progress_updates: 2025-02-13: Kickoff with PM, Eng, Design, Legal. Agreed scope: 24h snapshots + on-demand + reconciliation alerting
2025-02-18: Backend prototype for snapshot store completed (ENG spike). Uses compact JSON lines and GZIP for archival storage
2025-02-22: Legal provided required evidence schema (signed log, operator statement, retention declaration). Minor follow-ups outstanding
2025-02-26: Design mockups for sovereignty health panel (Lina Chen) reviewed; left-to-right card with drift meter approved
2025-02-28: Decided to reuse existing org-audit-role and add export permission rather than new RBAC primitives
2025-03-01: Reconciliation algorithm spike: compare declared pinset against last-30d dominant region (>60% traffic). First pass flags too many false positives; tuning needed
2025-03-03: Implemented export endpoint and S3 writer. Need to add time-bound signed manifests and rotate signing keys per Legal guidance
decisions: Use 24h default snapshot cadence; allow org-admins to reduce to 6h via tenant settings (trade-off: storage vs. freshness)
Evidence bundle format = ZIP of structured JSON + plain-text operator attestation + PGP-signed manifest; avoids heavy PDFs and keeps machine-readable artifacts
Reconciliation will use traffic-dominance heuristic (>=60% traffic in region != declared pin) to reduce noisy alerts; threshold configurable per-tenant
Exports are owner-scoped and logged to the audit stream; no automatic external sharing by default (opt-in)
Prefer incremental snapshots for storage efficiency: store full snapshot weekly + deltas daily
risks: Large orgs may generate many snapshots leading to storage cost blowouts if retention is not capped
Traffic-dominance heuristic might miss short-term routing anomalies that matter to compliance; follow-up eval with customer data required
Signing key management and long-term proof verification needs HSM/KMS integration (depends on Security team)
Exporting PII in evidence bundles if retention metadata is incomplete; need strict scrub rules
notes_for_engineering: Use consistent timestamps (UTC RFC3339) and include server-side signed manifest for each export
Add feature flag for reconciliation worker to tune thresholds in prod during initial rollout
Ensure export payloads run through the PII scrubber lambda before bundling
final_notes: Next milestone: customer pilot with two regulated tenants (finance + healthcare) scheduled for 2025-03-24. After pilot, adjust thresholds and retention caps and prepare compliance-ready runbook.
